[[File:BracketMatchPlayers.png|frameless|right]] This is a subtemplate that you will never use directly. It only renders the '''header row''' of the popups. It handles Player/team1 and Player/team1flag to the left, and Player/team2 + Player/team2flag to the right. After it, {{Tl|BracketMatchSummary}} renders all rows below, like date, maps, scores, overtime, etc. === BracketMatchPlayers2 === [[File:BracketMatchPlayers2.png|frameless|left]] For 2on2 contexts, used only by certain brackets ending with '' '2on2' '', where you want both teamname and teamlineups shown in the header, see {{Tl|BracketMatchPlayers2}}. It handles team1, team1flag and team1lineup to the left, and team2, team2flag and team2lineup to the right.



Adapted from [http://wiki.teamliquid.net/starcraft2/Template:BracketMatchPlayers Liquipedia]
